note:
1049 -> 1043, DERIVED FROM THE DELTA, not from a local absolute count.

The six that go are all one fix, in one file: odoo/service/security.py annotated
its parameters 'object', so mypy could not check the six things the module then
does with them --

  "object" has no attribute "uid" / "sid" / "session_token" /
  "_delete_old_sessions"; Value of type "object" is not indexable;
  Unsupported right operand type for in ("object")

-- and typing session as odoo.http.Session and request as odoo.http.Request under
TYPE_CHECKING resolves all six. Nothing else in the branch moved: diffing the
full gate output before and after the 15 commits gives six removals and zero
additions.

WHY DERIVED AND NOT MEASURED. The gate scope (-p odoo.orm -p odoo.db -p odoo.libs
-p odoo.http -p odoo.service -p odoo.modules) reports 1213 in the workspace this
was measured in and 1049 in CI; the absolute numbers disagree on environment, so
banking a local absolute would assert a count CI cannot reproduce. The DELTA does
not disagree: those six errors exist because a parameter was annotated 'object',
and they cannot survive the annotation regardless of environment. Measured before
1213 -> after 1207 on the same machine, same mypy, same config, one run each,
with the before taken in a detached worktree at 3325faaa612 so no working-tree
state is carried.

If CI reports anything other than 1043 on this commit, the derivation is what to
check first, not the fix.
